sentences.zh: 天福三年正月戊申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: On the first day (wushen) of the first month of the third year of Tianfu, the Emperor attended the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and insignia followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day in the first month of Tianfu 3, the emperor held audience in the Chongyuan Hall to receive felicitations; the guard of honor followed the usual form.

sentences.zh: 己酉，百官守司，以太史先奏日蝕故也。

translations.literal: On jiyou, all officials remained at their posts, because the Director of Astronomy had earlier reported an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the following day, all officials stayed at their posts, since the Director of Astronomy had already announced an impending solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 至是不虧，內外稱賀。

translations.literal: When the time came there was no eclipse; inside and outside the court offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: When the moment arrived the sun was not obscured, and court and capital alike rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，是夜以上元張燈於京城，縱都人遊樂，帝御大寧宮門樓觀之。

translations.literal: On renxu, that night for the Lantern Festival lamps were hung throughout the capital; the people of the metropolis were allowed to roam for pleasure, and the Emperor mounted the gate tower of the Daning Palace to watch.
translations.idiomatic: That night, for the Lantern Festival, the capital was hung with lights and the urban populace was free to roam in celebration; the emperor watched from the gate tower of the Daning Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，端明殿學士、禮部侍郎和凝兼判度支；

translations.literal: On bingyin, Duanming Hall academician and Vice Minister of Rites He Ning was additionally assigned to adjudicate the Bureau of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, He Ning, academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of Rites, was also put in charge of the Bureau of Revenue;

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎、判度支王松改尚書刑部侍郎；

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Works and acting adjudicator of the Bureau of Revenue Wang Song was changed to Vice Minister of Punishments in the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Song, Vice Minister of Works who had been adjudicating the Bureau of Revenue, was transferred to Vice Minister of Punishments in the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 戶部郎中高延賞改左諫議大夫，充諸道鹽鐵轉運副使。

translations.literal: Bureau of Accounts section member Gao Yanshang was changed to Left Remonstrance Councilor and appointed deputy commissioner for salt and iron transport in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yanshang, a section member in the Bureau of Accounts, was made Left Remonstrance Councilor and deputy commissioner for salt-and-iron transport on all circuits.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以前右諫議大夫薛融為左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On renshen, the former Right Remonstrance Councilor Xue Rong was made Left Remonstrance Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the former Right Remonstrance Councilor Xue Rong was appointed Left Remonstrance Councilor.

sentences.zh: 前興元節度使張筠卒於西京，輟視朝一日。

translations.literal: The former military governor of Xingyuan Zhang Yun died in the Western Capital; court audiences were suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: The former military governor of Xingyuan, Zhang Yun, died in the Western Capital, and court audiences were suspended for one day.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：太常禮院申：「準故事，前節度使無例輟朝。

translations.literal: (Documents of the Five Dynasties: The Directorate of Ceremonies of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "According to precedent, there is no instance of suspending court for a former military governor."
translations.idiomatic: (From the Documents of the Five Dynasties: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices Directorate of Ceremonies reported, "By precedent, court is never suspended for a former military governor."

sentences.zh: 」敕：「宜特輟一日朝參。」）〉

translations.literal: " Edict: "It is fitting to make an exceptional suspension of court attendance for one day.")〉
translations.idiomatic: " Imperial edict: "Suspend court attendance for one day as an exceptional mark of respect.")〉

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，左散騎常侍張允進《駁赦論》。

translations.literal: In the second month on gengchen, Left Regular Attendant Zhang Yun presented the "Treatise Refuting Amnesties."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengchen, Zhang Yun, Left Regular Attendant, submitted his "Treatise Refuting Amnesties."

sentences.zh: 帝覽而嘉之，降詔獎飾，仍付史館。

translations.literal: The Emperor read it and commended it, issued an edict to reward and adorn him, and also handed it to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor read it with approval, issued an edict praising him, and had the work forwarded to the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 甲申，荊南節度使高從誨加食邑實封。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the military governor of Jingnan Gao Conghui received an increase in fief income and actual enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Gao Conghui, military governor of Jingnan, was granted additional fief income and substantive enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 戊子，翰林學士李浣賜緋魚袋。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Hanlin academician Li Huan was granted the scarlet fish tally pouch.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the Hanlin academician Li Huan was awarded the scarlet fish tally pouch.

sentences.zh: 以尚書屯田員外郎、知制誥吳承範為庫部員外郎，充樞密院直學士。

translations.literal: Wu Chengfan, Secretariat section member for state farms and drafter of edicts, was made section member of the Storehouse Bureau and appointed direct academician of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chengfan, an outer Secretariat official in the state farms section who drafted edicts, was made an outer official in the Storehouse Bureau and appointed a direct academician of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 乙未，御劄曰：「曾有宣示百官，令進封事，今據到者未及十人。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an imperial note said: "I once announced to all officials that they should submit sealed memorials; now those received number fewer than ten."
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, an imperial note read: "I once directed all officials to submit sealed memorials, yet fewer than ten have arrived."

sentences.zh: 朕雖無德，自行敕後已是數月，至於假手於人，也合各有一件事敷奏。

translations.literal: Though I lack virtue, since I issued the edict several months have passed; even if one relies on others, each should still have one matter to lay before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: I may lack virtue, but months have passed since that edict; even those who rely on subordinates ought each to have brought at least one matter before me.

sentences.zh: 食祿於朝，豈當如是！

translations.literal: To eat the state's salary at court—how can it be thus!
translations.idiomatic: You draw salaries from the court—can this be acceptable?

sentences.zh: 言而不用，朕所甘心；

translations.literal: If you speak and I do not employ it, that is what I willingly accept;
translations.idiomatic: If you speak and I do not act on your words, I can accept that;

sentences.zh: 用而不言，誰之責也。

translations.literal: if I employ and you do not speak—whose responsibility is that?
translations.idiomatic: but if I need counsel and you stay silent—whose fault is that?

sentences.zh: 」丙申，制武清軍節度使馬希萼改威武軍節度使。

translations.literal: " On bingshen, an order was issued: the military governor of the Wuqing Army Ma Xi'e was changed to military governor of the Weiwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingshen, Ma Xi'e, military governor of the Wuqing Army, was reassigned as military governor of the Weiwu Army.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，中書上言：「《禮經》云：『禮不諱嫌名，二名不偏諱。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Secretariat reported: "The Book of Rites says: 'In ritual one does not avoid homophonic names; for double names one does not avoid only one of them.'
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Secretariat submitted: "The Book of Rites states, 'Ritual does not require avoiding homophonic names, and for double names one does not avoid only one of the two.'

sentences.zh: 』註云：「『嫌名，謂音聲相近，若禹與宇、邱與區也。

translations.literal: ' The commentary says: "'Homophonic name' means sounds that are close, such as Yu and yu, Qiu and qu.
translations.idiomatic: ' The commentary explains: "'Homophonic names' are names whose sounds are close, as with Yu and yu, or Qiu and qu.

sentences.zh: 二名不偏諱，謂孔子之母名徵在，言在不稱徵，言徵不稱在。

translations.literal: 'Not avoiding only one of a double name' means Confucius's mother was named Zhengzai: when speaking zai one did not say zheng, when speaking zheng one did not say zai.
translations.idiomatic: 'Not avoiding only one of a double name' refers to Confucius's mother, named Zhengzai: when using zai one did not say zheng, and when using zheng one did not say zai.

sentences.zh: 』此古禮也。

translations.literal: ' This is ancient ritual.
translations.idiomatic: ' Such was the ancient ritual.

sentences.zh: 唐太宗二名並諱，玄宗二名亦同；

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong of Tang avoided both names of a pair, and Emperor Xuanzong did the same for double names;
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong of Tang avoided both elements of double names, and Emperor Xuanzong followed the same practice;

sentences.zh: 人姓與國諱音聲相近是嫌名者，亦改姓氏，與古禮有異。

translations.literal: when a person's surname was homophonic with the state taboo, the surname was also changed—differing from ancient ritual.
translations.idiomatic: when a personal surname sounded like the imperial taboo, the surname was changed as well, which diverged from ancient practice.

sentences.zh: 廟諱平聲字，即不諱余三聲；

translations.literal: For temple taboos in level tone, the other three tones were not avoided;
translations.idiomatic: When the temple taboo was a level-tone character, the other three tones need not be avoided;

sentences.zh: 諱側聲，即不諱平聲字。

translations.literal: when the taboo was in oblique tone, level-tone characters were not avoided.
translations.idiomatic: when the taboo was in oblique tone, level-tone forms were not avoided.

sentences.zh: 所諱字正文及偏旁闕點畫，望依令式施行。

translations.literal: For taboo characters, whether in full form or in radicals with strokes omitted, we hope this may be carried out according to the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: For taboo characters, whether written in full or with strokes omitted in the character or its radicals, we ask that the prescribed regulations be followed.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「朝廷之制，今古相沿，道在人宏，禮非天降。

translations.literal: " An edict said: "Court institutions are handed down from past to present; the Way is enlarged by men, ritual does not descend from heaven.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict stated: "Court institutions have been handed down through the ages; the Way is enlarged by human effort, and ritual does not fall from heaven.

sentences.zh: 方開歷數，虔奉祖宗，雖逾孔子之文，未爽周公之訓。

translations.literal: As we inaugurate the dynastic count and reverently serve the ancestors, though we exceed Confucius's text, we have not departed from the Duke of Zhou's teaching.
translations.idiomatic: As we inaugurate our dynasty and reverently honor the ancestors, though we go beyond Confucius's letter, we have not strayed from the Duke of Zhou's intent.

sentences.zh: 所為二名及嫌名事，宜依唐禮施行。」

translations.literal: Matters concerning double names and homophonic names should be carried out according to Tang ritual."
translations.idiomatic: Matters concerning double names and homophonic names should follow Tang ritual practice.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （案：太原縣有史匡翰碑，立於天福八年。

translations.literal: (Note: In Taiyuan County there is a stele for Shi Kuanghan, erected in the eighth year of Tianfu.
translations.idiomatic: (Note: Taiyuan County has a stele for Shi Kuanghan, erected in Tianfu 8.

sentences.zh: 匡翰，建瑭之子也。

translations.literal: Kuanghan was the son of Jiantang.
translations.idiomatic: Kuanghan was the son of Jiantang.

sentences.zh: 碑於「瑭」字空文以避諱，而建瑭父敬思，仍書「敬」字，蓋當時避諱之體如此。）〉

translations.literal: On the stele the character tang was left blank to avoid the taboo, yet Jiantang's father Jingsi still has the character jing written—such was the form of taboo avoidance at the time.)〉
translations.idiomatic: On the stele the character tang was left blank for taboo avoidance, yet Jiantang's father Jingsi still appears with the character jing written out—such was taboo practice at the time.)〉

sentences.zh: 乙巳，天和節，宴近臣於廣政殿。

translations.literal: On yisi, on the Tianhe festival, the Emperor feasted close ministers in the Guangzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Tianhe festival, the emperor entertained close ministers in the Guangzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 四月丁亥，以尚書吏部侍郎盧詹為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on dinghai, Vice Minister of the Secretariat for Personnel Lu Zhan was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dinghai, Lu Zhan, Vice Minister of Personnel in the Secretariat, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人李詳上疏：「請沙汰在朝文武臣僚，以減冗食。

translations.literal: Palace Secretariat drafter Li Xiang submitted a memorial: "We ask to sift out civil and military officials at court in order to reduce redundant salaries."
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiang, a drafter in the Palace Secretariat, submitted a memorial: "I request a review to weed out redundant civil and military officials at court and reduce wasteful salaries."

sentences.zh: 仍條貫藩侯郡守，凡遇傅恩，不得多奏衙前職員，妄邀恩澤。

translations.literal: Also set regulations for feudal lords and prefects: whenever conferring favors, they must not report many yamen staff in order to seek favors without warrant.
translations.idiomatic: Also lay down rules for regional lords and prefects: whenever favors are granted, they must not inflate lists of yamen staff to seek unmerited rewards.

sentences.zh: 」疏奏，嘉之。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, it was commended.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted and received imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 戊子，宣武軍節度、侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、廣晉府行營都招討使楊光遠加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Yang Guangyuan—military governor of the Xuanwu Army, commander-in-chief of the Palace Guard horse and foot, and grand campaign commander of the Guangjin prefectural field headquarters—was additionally made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Xuanwu, overall commander of the Palace Guard horse and foot, and grand campaign commander of the Guangjin field headquarters, was also appointed Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 昭義節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使、廣晉府行營都排陣使杜重威，河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使、廣晉府行營馬步都虞候侯益，並加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: Du Chongwei, military governor of Zhaoyi and commander of the Palace Guard cavalry and array marshal of the Guangjin field headquarters, and Hou Yi, military governor of Heyang and commander of the Fengguo left and right wings and chief adjutant of horse and foot at the Guangjin field headquarters, were both made honorary Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Du Chongwei, military governor of Zhaoyi, cavalry commander of the Palace Guard, and array marshal of the Guangjin headquarters, and Hou Yi, military governor of Heyang, commander of the Fengguo wings, and chief adjutant of horse and foot at Guangjin, were both promoted to honorary Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、岐王李從嚴進封秦王，平盧軍節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令、臨淄王王建立進封東平王。

translations.literal: Li Congyan, military governor of Fengxiang, honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Grand Councilor, and Prince of Qi, was advanced to Prince of Qin; Wang Jianli, military governor of the Pinglu Army, honorary Grand Marshal, concurrent Grand Councilor, and Prince of Linzi, was advanced to Prince of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: Li Congyan of Fengxiang, honorary Grand Preceptor and Grand Councilor, Prince of Qi, was raised to Prince of Qin; Wang Jianli of Pinglu, honorary Grand Marshal and Grand Councilor, Prince of Linzi, was raised to Prince of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 甲午，泰寧軍節度使李從溫、西京留守京兆尹李周、歸德軍節度使趙在禮，並加兼侍中。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Li Congwen, military governor of the Taining Army; Li Zhou, Western Capital regent and metropolitan governor of Jingzhao; and Zhao Zaili, military governor of the Guide Army, were all additionally made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Li Congwen of Taining, Li Zhou, regent of the Western Capital and metropolitan governor of Jingzhao, and Zhao Zaili of Guide were all also appointed Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸道藩侯郡守皆等第加恩。

translations.literal: That month, feudal lords and prefects of all circuits received graded favors.
translations.idiomatic: That month, regional lords and prefects in every circuit received graded imperial favors.

sentences.zh: 改雍熙樓為章和樓，避廟諱也。

translations.literal: The Yongxi Tower was renamed the Zhanghe Tower, to avoid the temple taboo.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongxi Tower was renamed the Zhanghe Tower to avoid the imperial temple taboo.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: On the first day (dingwei) of the fifth month, the Emperor attended court in the Chongyuan Hall; guards and insignia followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, the emperor held audience in the Chongyuan Hall; the guard of honor followed the usual form.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔應諸州縣名犯廟諱者並改之。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict ordered that all prefectures and counties whose names violated the temple taboo should be renamed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, an edict ordered all prefectures and counties whose names violated the imperial temple taboo to be renamed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以楊光遠男承祚為檢校工部尚書、左威衛將軍、駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Yang Guangyuan's son Chengzuo was made honorary Minister of Works, general of the Left Weiwu Guard, and Commandant of the Imperial Sons-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Chengzuo, son of Yang Guangyuan, was appointed honorary Minister of Works, general of the Left Weiwu Guard, and Commandant of the Imperial Sons-in-law.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，魏府行營步軍都指揮使、檢校司徒、右神武統軍王周加檢校太保。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Wang Zhou, commander of foot at the Weizhou field headquarters, honorary Minister of Education, and commander of the Right Shenwu Army, was made honorary Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wang Zhou, foot commander at the Weizhou field headquarters, honorary Minister of Education, and commander of the Right Shenwu Army, was promoted to honorary Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，故振武節度使李嗣本贈太尉。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the late military governor of Zhenwu Li Siben was posthumously granted Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the late military governor of Zhenwu, Li Siben, was posthumously granted the title Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔：「中外臣僚，帶平章事、侍中、中書令及諸道節度使，並許私門立戟，仍並官給及據官品依令式處分。」

translations.literal: On jisi, an edict said: "Civil and military officials within and without the court who hold the titles of Grand Councilor, Palace Attendant, Secretariat Director, or military governor of a circuit are all permitted to set up halberds at their private gates; supplies shall also be provided by the state, and disposition shall follow rank according to the regulations."
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, an edict declared: "Officials at court and in the provinces who hold the titles of Grand Councilor, Palace Attendant, Secretariat Director, or military governor may erect ceremonial halberds at their private gates; the state shall supply them, and the number shall follow rank as prescribed in the regulations."

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，右監門衛上將軍王彥璘卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on dingchou, Wang Yanlin, senior general of the Right Gate Guard, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingchou, Wang Yanlin, senior general of the Right Gate Guard, died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以太子詹事王居敏制置安邑、解縣兩池榷鹽事。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Wang Jumin, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was put in charge of the salt monopoly at the Anyi and Jie county pools.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wang Jumin, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, was appointed to administer the salt monopoly at the Anyi and Jie pools.

sentences.zh: 左諫議大夫薛融上疏，請停修洛京大內。

translations.literal: Left Remonstrance Councilor Xue Rong submitted a memorial asking to halt construction of the great inner palace at Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Councilor, submitted a memorial requesting a halt to construction of the great inner palace at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 優詔褒之，尋罷營造。

translations.literal: A gracious edict praised him, and soon construction was halted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued a gracious edict praising him, and construction was soon halted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，翰林學士、尚書者工部郎中、知制誥竇貞固改中書舍人充職。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Dou Zhengu, Hanlin academician, Secretariat section member of the Ministry of Works, and drafter of edicts, was changed to Palace Secretariat drafter to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Dou Zhengu, Hanlin academician, Secretariat section member in the Ministry of Works, and edict drafter, was transferred to Palace Secretariat drafter to fill the post.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書致仕蕭蘧卒，贈右僕射。

translations.literal: Xiao Qu, retired Minister of Revenue, died and was posthumously granted Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Qu, the retired Minister of Revenue, died and was posthumously granted Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔貢舉宜權停一年，以員闕少而選人多，常調有淹滯故也。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the tribute examination should be suspended for one year, because vacancies were few while candidates were many and regular appointees were delayed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict suspended the civil service examinations for one year, since vacancies were scarce, candidates numerous, and regular appointees long delayed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔：「尚書司門應管諸闕令丞等，宜準唐天成四年四月四日敕，本司不得差補，只委闕鎮使鈐轄，見差補者，並畫時勒停訖奏聞。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict said: "For all pass magistrates and assistants under the Secretariat Office of Passes, follow the Tang edict of the fourth year of Tiancheng, fourth month, fourth day: this office must not make assignments; authority is vested only in the pass-town commissioners; any already assigned must be stopped at once and reported."
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, an edict declared: "For all pass magistrates and assistants under the Secretariat Office of Passes, follow the Tang edict of Tiancheng 4, month 4, day 4: this office may not make appointments; only pass-town commissioners have authority; any improper appointments must cease immediately and be reported."

sentences.zh: 應常帶使相節度使，自楊光遠已下凡七人，並改鄉里名號。」

translations.literal: All military governors who regularly hold the commissioner-and-councilor designation, from Yang Guangyuan downward seven in all, shall also change their native-place district names."
translations.idiomatic: All military governors who regularly hold commissioner-and-councilor rank, seven in all from Yang Guangyuan down, must also change their native-place district names.

sentences.zh: 七月丙午朔，差左諫議大夫薛融、秘書監呂琦、駕部員外郎兼侍御史知雜事劉皞、刑部郎中司徒詡、大理正張仁彖，同共詳定唐明宗朝編敕。

translations.literal: On the first day (bingwu) of the seventh month, Left Remonstrance Councilor Xue Rong, Director of the Palace Library Lü Qi, outer official of the Transport Bureau and concurrent investigating censor Liu Hao, section member of the Ministry of Punishments Situ Xu, and senior reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review Zhang Renmin were jointly dispatched to examine and fix the compiled edicts of the Tang Emperor Mingzong's reign.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, Xue Rong, Lü Qi, Liu Hao, Situ Xu, and Zhang Renmin were jointly assigned to review and finalize the compiled edicts of Emperor Mingzong of Tang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，御史中丞王延改尚書右丞，尚書右丞盧導改尚書吏部侍郎，以左諫議大夫薛融為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Censor-in-chief Wang Yan was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; Right Vice Director Lu Dao was made Vice Minister of Personnel in the Secretariat; Left Remonstrance Councilor Xue Rong was made Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Wang Yan, Censor-in-chief, became Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; Lu Dao, Right Vice Director, became Vice Minister of Personnel; and Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Councilor, became Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，制皇帝受命寶，以「受天明命，惟德允昌」為文。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the imperial seal of received mandate was ordered made, with the inscription "Receiving Heaven's clear mandate, virtue alone brings flourishing."
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the imperial Seal of Received Mandate was ordered cast with the inscription "Receiving Heaven's clear mandate; only virtue brings flourishing."

sentences.zh: 據《六典》，受命寶者，天子修封禪、禮神祇則用之，其始皆破皇業錢以制之。

translations.literal: According to the Six Institutions, the seal of received mandate was used when the Son of Heaven performed feng and shan sacrifices or worshipped the spirits; at first all were cast by melting imperial-estate coin.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Six Institutions, the Seal of Received Mandate was used when the Son of Heaven performed the feng and shan rites or worshipped the spirits; originally each was cast by melting coin from the imperial estate.

sentences.zh: 皇業者，藩邸主事之所有也。

translations.literal: Imperial estate coin was what the prince's residence steward held.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial-estate coin was property held by the prince's household steward.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：天福三年六月，中書門下奏：「準敕，制皇帝受命寶。

translations.literal: (Documents of the Five Dynasties: In the sixth month of the third year of Tianfu, the Secretariat reported: "By edict, the imperial seal of received mandate is to be made."
translations.idiomatic: (From the Documents of the Five Dynasties: In the sixth month of Tianfu 3, the Secretariat reported, "By edict, the imperial Seal of Received Mandate is to be cast."

sentences.zh: 今按唐貞觀十六年，太宗文皇帝所刻之璽，白玉為螭首，其文曰『皇帝景命，有德者昌』。

translations.literal: Now examining the Tang, in the sixteenth year of Zhenguan the literary Emperor Taizong had a seal carved with white jade and a dragon head; its text read 'The Emperor's bright mandate—he who has virtue flourishes.'
translations.idiomatic: We find that in Tang Zhenguan 16, Emperor Taizong had a seal carved of white jade with a dragon head, inscribed "The Emperor's bright mandate: he who has virtue flourishes."

sentences.zh: 」敕：「宜以『受天明命，惟德允昌』為文刻之。」）〉

translations.literal: " Edict: "It is fitting to inscribe it with the text 'Receiving Heaven's clear mandate, virtue alone brings flourishing.'")〉
translations.idiomatic: " Edict: "Inscribe it with the text 'Receiving Heaven's clear mandate; only virtue brings flourishing.'")〉

sentences.zh: 壬戌，虞部郎中、知制誥於遘改中書舍人。

translations.literal: On renxu, Yu Gou, section member of the Parks Bureau and drafter of edicts, was changed to Palace Secretariat drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yu Gou, section member in the Parks Bureau and edict drafter, was appointed Palace Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 宰臣趙瑩、桑維翰、李崧各改鄉里名號。

translations.literal: Chief ministers Zhao Ying, Sang Weihan, and Li Song each changed their native-place district names.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers Zhao Ying, Sang Weihan, and Li Song each changed their native-place district names.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度使高從誨本貫汴州浚儀縣王畿鄉表節東坊，改為擁旌鄉浴鳳裏。

translations.literal: Gao Conghui, military governor of Jingnan, was originally registered in Wangji township, Junyi county, Bian prefecture, Biaojie East ward; it was changed to Yongjing township, Yufeng lane.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Conghui of Jingnan, originally registered in Biaojie East ward, Wangji township, Junyi county, Bianzhou, had his registration changed to Yufeng lane, Yongjing township.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，以左僕射劉句為契丹冊禮使，左散騎常侍韋勛副之，給事中盧重為契丹皇太后冊禮使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on wuyin, Left Vice Director Liu Gou was made Khitan investiture envoy; Left Regular Attendant Wei Xun was his deputy; Drafting Attendant Lu Chong was made investiture envoy to the Khitan empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuyin, Liu Gou, Left Vice Director, was appointed Khitan investiture envoy, with Wei Xun, Left Regular Attendant, as deputy; Lu Chong, Drafting Attendant, was appointed investiture envoy to the Khitan empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 壬午，魏府軍前奏，前澶州刺史馮暉自逆城來歸。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Weizhou army front reported that the former prefect of Chanzhou Feng Hui had come over from the rebel city.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Weizhou field army reported that Feng Hui, former prefect of Chanzhou, had surrendered from the rebel stronghold.

sentences.zh: 定州奏，境內旱，民多流散。

translations.literal: Ding prefecture reported drought within its borders and many people scattered in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou reported drought within its territory and widespread displacement of the populace.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕自臨寰宇，每念生民，務切撫綏，期於富庶，屬干戈之未戢，慮徭役之或煩。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Since I ascended to rule the realm, I constantly think of the people, striving to soothe and reassure them and hoping for wealth and plenty; as arms have not yet been laid down, I fear corvée labor may become burdensome."
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "Since I took the throne I have constantly thought of the people, striving to comfort them and bring prosperity; yet with war not yet ended, I fear that labor levies may become oppressive."

sentences.zh: 惟彼中山，偶經夏旱，因茲疾苦，遽至流移，達我聽聞，深懷憫惻。

translations.literal: Only at Zhongshan, having chanced to suffer summer drought, through this hardship people swiftly fled; reaching my ears, I am deeply moved to compassion.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongshan alone has suffered an unexpected summer drought; hardship has driven people to flee in numbers that have reached my ears and stirred deep compassion.

sentences.zh: 應定州所差軍前夫役逃戶夏秋稅並放。

translations.literal: All summer and autumn taxes owed by fugitive households previously levied for military husbandry labor in Ding prefecture are remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All summer and autumn taxes owed by fugitive households previously levied for military labor service in Dingzhou are remitted.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，襄州奏，漢江水漲一丈一尺。

translations.literal: " On jiashen, Xiang prefecture reported the Han River had risen one zhang and one chi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Xiangzhou reported that the Han River had risen eleven feet.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以前澶州刺史馮暉為檢校太保，充義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: On jichou, the former prefect of Chanzhou Feng Hui was made honorary Grand Guardian and appointed military governor of the Yicheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Feng Hui, former prefect of Chanzhou, was appointed honorary Grand Guardian and military governor of Yicheng.

sentences.zh: 詔：「河府、同州、絳州等三處災旱，逃移人戶下所欠累年殘稅，並今年夏稅差科，及麥苗子沿征諸色錢物等並放。

translations.literal: An edict said: "At the three places He prefecture, Tong prefecture, and Jiang prefecture, where drought brought disaster, all arrears of taxes for years past owed by displaced households, this year's summer levies and assignments, and all assorted monies levied along with wheat-seedling taxes are remitted."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "For He prefecture, Tongzhou, and Jiangzhou, where drought has brought disaster, all tax arrears owed by displaced households, this year's summer levies, and all assorted charges including wheat-seedling taxes are remitted."

sentences.zh: 其逃戶下秋苗，據見檢到數不計是元額及出剩頃畝，並放一半。

translations.literal: For autumn grain tax on fugitive households, according to the amount actually verified, regardless of original quota or surplus mu, half is remitted.
translations.idiomatic: For autumn grain tax on fugitive households, based on verified amounts regardless of original quota or surplus acreage, half is remitted.

sentences.zh: 委觀察使散行曉諭，專切招攜。

translations.literal: This is entrusted to the surveillance commissioners to circulate proclamations and devote themselves to summoning people back.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance commissioners are charged to circulate proclamations and devote themselves to bringing people back.

sentences.zh: 應歸業戶人，仍指揮逐縣切加安撫。

translations.literal: Households that return to their occupations are also to be ordered county by county to receive earnest reassurance.
translations.idiomatic: Households that return to their occupations are to be earnestly reassured, county by county, as directed.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，翰林學士、中書舍人竇貞固上言：「請令文武百僚，逐司之內，各奏舉一人，述其人有某能，堪為某官某職。

translations.literal: " On bingshen, Dou Zhengu, Hanlin academician and Palace Secretariat drafter, reported: "We ask that civil and military officials in each bureau each recommend one person, stating what ability the person has and what office or post he is fit for."
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Dou Zhengu, Hanlin academician and Palace Secretariat drafter, proposed: "Let every civil and military bureau each recommend one person, stating his abilities and the office or post for which he is suited."

sentences.zh: 據所薦否藏，定舉主黜陟。」

translations.literal: According to whether the recommendation proves true or false, determine promotion or demotion of the recommender."
translations.idiomatic: Promotion or demotion of the recommender shall depend on whether the recommendation proves true or false.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《宋史·竇貞固傳》載此疏，略云：為國之要，進賢是先。

translations.literal: (The Song History biography of Dou Zhengu records this memorial, summarizing: The essential of governing a state is to advance the worthy first.
translations.idiomatic: (The biography of Dou Zhengu in the Song History records this memorial, in summary: The essential task of governing a state is to advance the worthy first.

sentences.zh: 陛下方樹丕基，宜求多士。

translations.literal: Your Majesty is just establishing the great foundation; you should seek many scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is just laying the foundations of the dynasty; you should seek many capable men.

sentences.zh: 乞降詔百僚，令各司議定一人，有何能識，堪何職官，朝廷依奏用之。

translations.literal: We beg that an edict be issued to all officials ordering each bureau to select one person, stating what ability and knowledge he has and what office he is fit for, and the court will employ him according to the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that Your Majesty issue an edict to all officials, directing each bureau to nominate one person, stating his abilities and the office for which he is suited, and the court will appoint him as recommended.

sentences.zh: 若能符薦引，果謂當才，所奏之官，望加獎賞。

translations.literal: If the recommendation proves true and the person is truly capable, the office reported should receive added reward.
translations.idiomatic: If the recommendation proves true and the nominee is truly capable, the office he holds should receive added reward.

sentences.zh: 如乖其舉，或涉徇私，所奏之官，宜加黜罰。

translations.literal: If it fails the recommendation or involves private favor, the office reported should receive added demotion or punishment.
translations.idiomatic: If the recommendation fails or involves favoritism, the recommender's office should face added demotion or punishment.

sentences.zh: 自然官由德序，位以才升。

translations.literal: Naturally offices will follow virtue in order and positions rise by talent.
translations.idiomatic: Thus offices will be ordered by virtue and positions advanced by talent.

sentences.zh: 三人同行，尚聞擇善；

translations.literal: When three walk together, one still hears of choosing the good;
translations.idiomatic: Even when three walk together, one may still choose the good among them;

sentences.zh: 十目所視，必不濫知。

translations.literal: with ten eyes watching, knowledge will surely not be applied indiscriminately.
translations.idiomatic: with ten eyes upon him, talent will surely not be misjudged.

sentences.zh: 臣職在論思，敢陳狂狷。）〉

translations.literal: My duty is to deliberate and reflect; I dare set forth this blunt and narrow-minded counsel.)〉
translations.idiomatic: My office is to counsel the throne; I venture this frank and unorthodox proposal.)〉

sentences.zh: 疏奏，嘉之。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; the emperor commended it.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was presented and received imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 仍令文武百官於搢紳之內、草澤之中，知灼然有才器者，列名以奏。

translations.literal: He still ordered civil and military officials, among gentry and among commoners in the wilds, to list by name and submit those who clearly had talent and capacity.
translations.idiomatic: He further directed all civil and military officials to nominate, from among the gentry and from the common people, anyone of manifest talent, reporting their names in memorials.

sentences.zh: 宴契丹冊禮使於廣政殿。

translations.literal: He feasted the Khitan envoy for the investiture ceremony in the Guangzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor entertained the Khitan envoy bearing the investiture patent in the Guangzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，鄆州奏，陽谷縣界河決。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Yan Prefecture reported that the river breached its banks at the Yanggu county border.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Yanzhou reported a breach of the river at the Yanggu county boundary.

sentences.zh: 青州王建立奏，高麗國宿衛質子王仁翟乞放歸鄉里。

translations.literal: Wang Jianli of Qing Prefecture reported that Wang Renzhai, a Goryeo hostage serving as palace guard, begged to be released to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jianli of Qingzhou memorialized that Wang Renzhai, a Goryeo hostage serving in the imperial guard, asked to be sent home.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，鎮、邢、定三州奏，奉詔共差樂官六十七人往契丹。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Zhen, Xing, and Ding prefectures reported that pursuant to an edict they jointly dispatched sixty-seven music officers to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zhenzhou, Xingzhou, and Dingzhou reported that by imperial order they had jointly sent sixty-seven music officers to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 詔：「魏府城下，自屯軍已來，墳墓多經劚掘。

translations.literal: Edict: "Below Weifu city, since the garrison was stationed, many tombs have been dug up.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Around Weifu, since troops were encamped there, many graves have been plundered by digging.

sentences.zh: 雖已差人收掩，今更遣太僕卿邢德昭往伸祭奠。」

translations.literal: Although persons were already dispatched to gather and re-inter them, now the Minister of Imperial Studs Xing Dezhao is further sent to perform obsequies."
translations.idiomatic: Although reburial parties were already sent, Xing Dezhao, Minister of the Imperial Studs, is now additionally dispatched to offer sacrifices and rites of mourning."

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，宮苑使焦繼勛自軍前押範延光牙將馬諤賫歸命請罪表到闕。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on jiyou, the Palace Parks commissioner Jiao Jixun from the front escorted Fan Yanguang's junior general Ma E bearing a table of surrender and plea for pardon to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiyou, Jiao Jixun, commissioner of palace parks, arrived at court from the front escorting Ma E, a staff officer of Fan Yanguang, who carried a memorial of surrender and plea for pardon.

sentences.zh: 壬子，延光領部下將士素服於本府門俟命，有詔釋罪。

translations.literal: On renzi, Yanguang led his subordinate officers and soldiers in plain dress at his prefectural gate awaiting orders; an edict released them from guilt.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Fan Yanguang led his officers and troops in undyed mourning dress to wait at his headquarters gate for orders; an edict pardoned them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔司空兼門下侍郎、平章事馮道官一品，給門戟十六枝，中書侍郎平章事桑維翰、李崧給門戟十二枝。

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict made Feng Dao, Grand Master and concurrently Vice Director of the Chancellery and Chief Minister, rank of the first grade, and granted sixteen gate halberds; Sang Weihan and Li Song, Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Chief Ministers, were granted twelve gate halberds each.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, an edict ranked Feng Dao, Grand Master concurrent with Vice Director of the Chancellery and Chief Minister, as first grade and granted him sixteen ceremonial gate halberds; Sang Weihan and Li Song, Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Chief Ministers, received twelve each.

sentences.zh: 己未，宣遣靜鞭官劉守威、左金吾仗勘契官王英、司天臺雞叫學生商暉等並赴契丹。

translations.literal: On jiwei, it was announced that the silent whip officer Liu Shouwei, the Left Golden Guard tally officer Wang Ying, the Directorate of Astronomy cock-crow student Shang Hui, and others were all sent to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Liu Shouwei, officer of the silent whip; Wang Ying, tally officer of the Left Golden Guard of Honor; Shang Hui, student of the cock-crow rite at the Directorate of Astronomy; and others were all dispatched to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，契丹使人往洛京般取趙氏公主。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Khitan envoys went to the Luoyang capital to transport Lady Zhao the princess.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Khitan envoys went to Luoyang to fetch Princess Zhao.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《宋史·趙贊傳》：德鈞父子降晉，契丹盡錮之北去，贊獨與母公主留西洛。

translations.literal: (The Song History biography of Zhao Zan: When Dejun and his son surrendered to Jin, the Khitan shackled them all and took them north; Zan alone remained in the Western Capital with his mother the princess.
translations.idiomatic: (From the biography of Zhao Zan in the Song History: When Dejun and his son submitted to Jin, the Khitan shackled them and marched them north; only Zan remained in Luoyang with his mother the princess.

sentences.zh: 天福三年，晉祖命贊奉母歸薊門。）〉

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianfu, the Jin founder ordered Zan to accompany his mother back to Jimen.)〉
translations.idiomatic: In Tianfu 3, the Jin founder ordered Zan to escort his mother back to Jimen.)〉

sentences.zh: 襄州奏，漢江水漲三丈，出岸害稼。

translations.literal: Xiang Prefecture reported that the Han River rose three zhang, overflowed its banks, and harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangzhou reported that the Han River rose thirty feet above normal, spilled over its banks, and damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 東都奏，洛陽水漲一丈五尺，壞下浮橋。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital reported that Luoyang's waters rose one zhang and five chi, destroying the lower pontoon bridge.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital reported that Luoyang's river rose fifteen feet and wrecked the lower floating bridge.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，于闐國王楊仁美遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On yichou, the Khotan king Yang Renmei sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Yang Renmei, king of Khotan, sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 回鶻可汗遣使貢駝馬。

translations.literal: The Uyghur khan sent envoys presenting camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: The Uyghur khan sent envoys with tribute of camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，趙延壽進馬謝恩，放燕國長公主歸幽州。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Zhao Yanshou presented horses in thanks for grace; the Yan Kingdom senior princess was released to return to Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhao Yanshou presented horses in gratitude; the senior princess of Yan was permitted to return to Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 範延光差節度副使李式到闕，奉表首罪，兼進玉帶一條。

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang sent his deputy military governor Li Shi to court, submitting a table acknowledging guilt and also presenting one jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang dispatched his deputy commissioner Li Shi to court with a memorial confessing guilt and a jade belt as tribute.

sentences.zh: 遣宣徽南院使劉處讓權知魏府軍府事。

translations.literal: Liu Churang, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was dispatched to serve provisionally as administrator of the Weifu military prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Churang, envoy of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was sent to administer Weifu on a provisional basis.

sentences.zh: 己巳，復範延光官爵，其制略曰：「頃朕始登大寶，未靜中原，六飛才及於京師，千里未通於懷抱。

translations.literal: On jisi, Fan Yanguang's offices and enfeoffments were restored; the rescript in summary said: "Recently when I first ascended the great throne, the Central Plains were not yet pacified; the imperial carriage had only just reached the capital, and a thousand li did not yet reach my embrace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Fan Yanguang's rank and titles were restored; the rescript summarized: "When I first took the throne, the heartland was still unsettled; the court had only just returned to the capital, and distant regions lay beyond my reach.

sentences.zh: 楚王求舊，方在遺簪；

translations.literal: The King of Chu sought his old friend, yet only an abandoned hairpin remained;
translations.idiomatic: Like the King of Chu seeking an old friend, only a token hairpin was left;

sentences.zh: 曾子傳疑，忽成投杼。

translations.literal: Zengzi passed on doubt, and suddenly it became casting aside the shuttle;
translations.idiomatic: Doubt spread about Zengzi, and loyalty suddenly looked like betrayal;

sentences.zh: 尋聞悛悔，遽戮奸回，干戈俄至於經時，雷雨因思於作解。

translations.literal: Soon hearing repentance, swiftly executing treacherous followers; weapons of war soon lasted a full season; thunder and rain then stirred thoughts of granting release.
translations.idiomatic: Soon we heard of repentance, and traitors were swiftly punished; war dragged on for a season until, like thunder after rain, mercy could be considered.

sentences.zh: 果馳賓介，疊貢表章，向丹闕以傾心，瀝衷誠而效順。

translations.literal: Truly envoys were dispatched in haste, memorials submitted in succession, turning the heart toward the cinnabar gate, pouring out inner sincerity to render obedience.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys came posthaste and memorials followed one after another, pledging loyalty before the imperial court and offering sincere submission.

sentences.zh: 而況保全黎庶，完整甲兵，納款斯來，其功非細。

translations.literal: Moreover preserving the common people, keeping arms and armor intact, coming with submission of good faith—the merit is no small matter.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover you preserved the people, kept your forces intact, and came in submission—your service was no small thing.

sentences.zh: 得不特頒鐵契，重建牙章，封本郡之土茅，移樂郊之旌鉞。

translations.literal: How could one not specially issue an iron covenant, rebuild the military standard, enfeoff with the local earth and thatch of one's prefecture, and transfer the banners and axes of the music capital?
translations.idiomatic: Surely you deserve a special iron covenant, restoration of your command insignia, enfeoffment in your home command, and transfer of the banners and axes of honor.

sentences.zh: 至於將吏，鹹降絲綸。

translations.literal: As for officers and clerks, all received imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Your officers and staff as well were all granted imperial appointments.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Ah!

sentences.zh: 上穹之運四時，不愆者信；

translations.literal: Heaven above moves the four seasons—what does not err is faithfulness;
translations.idiomatic: Heaven turns the seasons without fail, and what it never breaks is faith;

sentences.zh: 大道之崇三寶，所重者慈。

translations.literal: The Great Way exalts the Three Treasures—what it values is compassion.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Way honors the Three Treasures, and what it esteems is mercy.

sentences.zh: 活萬戶之傷夷，息六師之勞瘁。

translations.literal: Reviving the wounded of ten thousand households, resting the weariness of the six armies.
translations.idiomatic: To heal the wounds of countless households and spare the six armies further toil.

sentences.zh: 遂予仁憫，旌爾變通。

translations.literal: Thus granting humane compassion, commending your flexibility in change.
translations.idiomatic: We therefore show you mercy and honor your readiness to turn back to loyalty.

sentences.zh: 永貽子孫，長守富貴，敬佩光寵，可不美歟！

translations.literal: Eternally bestowing on your descendants, long guarding wealth and honor, reverently receiving this glorious favor—is it not beautiful!
translations.idiomatic: May wealth and honor endure for your house for generations; receive this splendid grace with reverence—how fine a reward!

sentences.zh: 可復推誠奉義佐運致理功臣、天雄軍節度、管內觀察處置等使、開府儀同三司、守太傅、兼中書令、廣晉尹、上柱國、臨清王，食邑一萬戶，食實封一千戶，改授鄆州刺史、天平軍節度、鄆齊

translations.literal: He may be restored as Merit Minister Who Sincerely Serves Righteousness and Assists Destiny in Establishing Order, military governor of the Tianxiong Army, commissioner for observation and disposition of affairs within the circuit, Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial ranking as the Three Excellencies, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrently Director of the Secretariat, Guangjin Grand Administrator, Upper Pillar of the State, Prince of Linqing, with an enfeoffment income of ten thousand households and a substantive enfeoffment of one thousand households; transferred and appointed Prefect of Yan, military governor of the Tianping Army, and governor of Yan, Qi
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang is restored as Merit Minister for Sincere Righteous Service in Establishing the Dynasty, military governor of Tianxiong, commissioner for circuit observation and disposition, Grand Preceptor of the First Rank with the same honors as the Three Excellencies, acting Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, Guangjin Grand Administrator, Upper Pillar of the State, and Prince of Linqing, with a fief income of ten thousand households and one thousand substantive households; he is reassigned as Prefect of Yanzhou, military governor of Tianping, and commander of Yanzhou, Qizhou

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （原本闕一字。）〉

translations.literal: (The original text lacks one character.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (One character is missing in the original text.)〉

sentences.zh: 等州觀察處置等使，賜鐵券，改封高平郡王，仍令擇日備禮冊命。

translations.literal: and other prefectures, commissioner for observation and disposition, granted an iron covenant, changed in enfeoffment to Prince of the Gaoping Commandery, and still ordered to choose a day and prepare the ceremonial patent of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: and other prefectures as observation and disposition commissioner; an iron covenant was granted and his title was changed to Prince of Gaoping Commandery, with orders to choose a day for the formal investiture ceremony.

sentences.zh: 」以天雄軍節度副使、檢校刑部尚書李式檢校尚書右僕射，充亳州團練使；

translations.literal: " Li Shi, deputy military governor of the Tianxiong Army and Minister of Punishments by examination, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs by examination and appointed prefectural militia commissioner of Bozhou;
translations.idiomatic: " Li Shi, deputy commissioner of Tianxiong and examined Minister of Punishments, was made examined Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and prefectural militia commissioner of Bozhou;

sentences.zh: 以貝州刺史孫漢威為檢校太保、隴州防禦使；

translations.literal: Sun Hanwei, Prefect of Bei, was made Grand Preceptor by examination and defense commissioner of Long;
translations.idiomatic: Sun Hanwei, prefect of Beizhou, was appointed examined Grand Preceptor and defense commissioner of Longzhou;

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍三城都巡檢使薛霸為檢校司空、衛州刺史；

translations.literal: Xue Ba, metropolitan inspector of the three cities of the Tianxiong Army, was made Grand Master by examination and Prefect of Wei;
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ba, metropolitan inspector of Tianxiong's three cities, was appointed examined Grand Master and Prefect of Weizhou;

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍馬步軍都指揮使五建為檢校司空、虢州刺史；

translations.literal: Wang Jian, commander of the Tianxiong Army horse and foot forces, was made Grand Master by examination and Prefect of Guo;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian, overall commander of Tianxiong cavalry and infantry, was appointed examined Grand Master and Prefect of Guozhou;

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍內外馬軍都指揮使藥元福為檢校司空、深州刺史；

translations.literal: Yao Yuanfu, commander of the inner and outer horse forces of the Tianxiong Army, was made Grand Master by examination and Prefect of Shen;
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanfu, commander of Tianxiong's inner and outer cavalry, was appointed examined Grand Master and Prefect of Shenzhou;

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍內外步軍都指揮使安元霸為檢校司空、隨州刺史；

translations.literal: An Yuanba, commander of the inner and outer foot forces of the Tianxiong Army, was made Grand Master by examination and Prefect of Sui;
translations.idiomatic: An Yuanba, commander of Tianxiong's inner and outer infantry, was appointed examined Grand Master and Prefect of Suizhou;

sentences.zh: 以天雄軍都監、前河陽行軍司馬李彥珣為檢校司空、坊州刺史。

translations.literal: Li Yanxun, army supervisor of the Tianxiong Army and former marching chief of staff of Heyang, was made Grand Master by examination and Prefect of Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yanxun, army supervisor of Tianxiong and former chief of staff on the Heyang campaign, was appointed examined Grand Master and Prefect of Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 李式，延光之舊僚也，其餘皆延光之將佐也，故有是命。

translations.literal: Li Shi was Yanguang's old subordinate; the rest were all Yanguang's generals and aides—hence these appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi was a former associate of Fan Yanguang, and the others were all his officers and aides—hence these appointments.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣客省使李守貞押器幣賜魏府立功將校。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the Reception Bureau envoy Li Shouzhen was dispatched escorting vessels and silks to bestow on meritorious officers and soldiers of Weifu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Li Shouzhen, envoy of the Reception Bureau, was sent with ceremonial vessels and silks to reward the officers who had distinguished themselves at Weifu.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以魏府招討使楊光遠檢校太師、兼中書令，行廣晉尹，充天雄軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Yang Guangyuan, pacification commissioner of Weifu, was made Grand Preceptor by examination and concurrently Director of the Secretariat, acting Guangjin Grand Administrator, and appointed military governor of the Tianxiong Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Yang Guangyuan, pacification commissioner of Weifu, was appointed examined Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat, acting Guangjin Grand Administrator, and military governor of Tianxiong.

sentences.zh: 十月乙亥，福建節度使王繼恭遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on yihai, Wang Jigong, military governor of Fujian, sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yihai, Wang Jigong, military governor of Fujian, sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，契丹命使以寶冊上帝徽號曰英武明義皇帝。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Khitan envoy bearing the patent of appointment invested the Emperor with the honorific title Resplendent Martial and Bright Righteousness Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, a Khitan envoy bearing the investiture patent bestowed on the emperor the honorific title Resplendent Martial and Bright Righteousness Emperor.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《歐陽史》作契丹使中書令韓頻來奉冊。）〉

translations.literal: (The History of Ouyang Xiu records that the Khitan envoy, Secretariat Director Han Pin, came bearing the patent.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Ouyang Xiu's history records that Han Pin, Khitan envoy and Secretariat Director, came bearing the investiture patent.)〉

sentences.zh: 是日，左右金吾、六軍儀仗、太常鼓吹等並出城迎引至崇元殿前，陳列如儀。

translations.literal: That day, the Left and Right Golden Guards, the six armies' guard of honor, the Directorate of Music's processional music, and others all went out of the city to welcome and escort them to before the Chongyuan Hall, where they were arrayed according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Left and Right Golden Guards, the six armies' guard of honor, and the Directorate of Music's ceremonial musicians all went out to welcome the envoy and escort him to the Chongyuan Hall, where the formations were arranged according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 鄆州範延光奏到任內。

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang of Yan Prefecture reported that he had arrived and assumed office within the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang of Yanzhou reported that he had arrived and taken up his post within the circuit.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，御劄曰：「為國之規，在於敏政；

translations.literal: On gengchen, an imperial note read: "The rule for governing a state lies in diligent administration;
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, an imperial note read: "The principle of governing a state lies in diligent administration;

sentences.zh: 建都之法，務要利民。

translations.literal: The method of establishing a capital must above all benefit the people.
translations.idiomatic: The method of choosing a capital must above all serve the people's welfare.

sentences.zh: 歷考前經，朗然通論，顧惟涼德，獲啟丕基。

translations.literal: Examining the classics of former ages, the principle is plainly understood; considering my meager virtue, I have been enabled to inaugurate the great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing the classics of earlier ages, the principle is clear; though my virtue is slight, I have been granted the founding of a new dynasty.

sentences.zh: 當數朝戰伐之餘，是兆庶傷殘之後，車徒既廣，帑廩鹹虛。

translations.literal: At a time after warfare spanning several reigns, when the myriad people had just suffered devastation, transport and troops were already extensive and the treasury and granaries were all empty.
translations.idiomatic: Coming after generations of war, when the people were still recovering from devastation, transport costs and military levies were already heavy and the treasury and granaries stood empty.

sentences.zh: 經年之免粟飛芻，繼日而勞民動眾，常煩漕運，不給供須。

translations.literal: Year after year grain and fodder were exempted and rushed in; day after day the people were wearied and masses mobilized; transport by canal was constantly strained and supplies could not be met.
translations.idiomatic: Year after year grain and fodder had to be rushed in; day after day the people were burdened and masses mobilized; canal transport was constantly overtaxed and supplies could not keep pace.

sentences.zh: 今汴州水陸要沖，山河形勝，乃萬庾千箱之地，是四通八達之郊。

translations.literal: Now Bian Prefecture is a strategic junction by water and land, with commanding terrain of mountains and rivers; it is a land of myriad granaries and a thousand storehouses, a suburb reaching in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: Bianzhou now stands at a strategic junction of waterways and roads, with commanding terrain; it is a land of abundant granaries and a hub reaching in every direction.

sentences.zh: 爰自按巡，益觀宜便，俾升都邑，以利兵民。

translations.literal: Since personally inspecting on tour, I have further observed its suitability and convenience; let the capital be elevated here to benefit soldiers and people.
translations.idiomatic: On inspection tours I have seen its advantages clearly; the capital should be moved here to benefit both the army and the people.

sentences.zh: 汴州宜升為東京，置開封府。

translations.literal: Bian Prefecture should be elevated to the Eastern Capital and the Kaifeng Prefecture established.
translations.idiomatic: Bianzhou should be elevated to the Eastern Capital and the Kaifeng Prefecture established.

sentences.zh: 仍升開封、浚儀兩縣為赤縣，其餘升為畿縣。

translations.literal: Kaifeng and Junyi counties are further elevated to imperial counties; the rest are elevated to capital-district counties.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng and Junyi counties are further elevated to imperial counties; the remaining counties are elevated to capital-district counties.

sentences.zh: 應舊置開封府時所管屬縣，並可仍舊割屬收管，亦升為畿縣。

translations.literal: All counties formerly under jurisdiction when the Kaifeng Prefecture was established may still be transferred and placed under its administration as before, and are also elevated to capital-district counties.
translations.idiomatic: All counties that fell under Kaifeng Prefecture when it was first established may remain under its jurisdiction as before and are likewise elevated to capital-district counties.

sentences.zh: 其洛京改為西京；

translations.literal: Luoyang is changed to the Western Capital;
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang is redesignated the Western Capital;

sentences.zh: 其雍京改為晉昌軍，留守改為節度觀察使，依舊為京兆府，列在七府之上；

translations.literal: Yongjing is changed to the Jinchang Army; the garrison commissioner is changed to military governor and observation commissioner; it remains the Jingzhao Prefecture as before, ranked above the seven prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an is redesignated the Jinchang Army; the garrison commissioner becomes military governor and observation commissioner; it remains Jingzhao Prefecture as before, ranked above the seven metropolitan prefectures;

sentences.zh: 其曹州改為防禦州。

translations.literal: Cao Prefecture is changed to a defense prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Caozhou is redesignated a defense prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其餘制置，並委中書門下商量施行。

translations.literal: The remaining arrangements are all entrusted to the Secretariat and Chancellery to discuss and implement.
translations.idiomatic: All remaining arrangements are entrusted to the Secretariat and Chancellery to discuss and carry out.

sentences.zh: 」丙戌，以護聖左廂都指揮使、曹州刺史張彥澤為鎮國軍節度使，以工部尚書裴皞為尚書右僕射致仕。

translations.literal: " On bingxu, Zhang Yanze, commander of the Left Wing of the Imperial Guard Army and Prefect of Cao, was made military governor of the Zhenguo Army; Pei Hao, Minister of Works, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and retired.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingxu, Zhang Yanze, commander of the Left Wing of the Imperial Guard Army and prefect of Caozhou, was appointed military governor of Zhenguo; Pei Hao, Minister of Works, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and granted retirement.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔改大寧宮門為明德門。

translations.literal: That day, an edict changed the Daning Palace gate to the Gate of Bright Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict renamed the Daning Palace gate the Gate of Bright Virtue.

sentences.zh: 又改京城諸門名額，南門尉氏以薰風為名，西二門鄭門、梁門以金義、乾明為名，北二門酸棗門、封丘門以元化、宣陽為名，東二門曹門、宋門以迎春、仁和為名。

translations.literal: The name plaques of the capital's gates were also changed: the southern Weishi Gate was named Fragrant Breeze; the two western gates, Zheng Gate and Liang Gate, were named Golden Righteousness and Qianming; the two northern gates, Sour Jujube Gate and Fengqiu Gate, were named Primordial Transformation and Xuan Yang; the two eastern gates, Cao Gate and Song Gate, were named Welcoming Spring and Renhe.
translations.idiomatic: The capital's gate names were also changed: the southern Weishi Gate became Fragrant Breeze; the western Zheng and Liang gates became Golden Righteousness and Qianming; the northern Sour Jujube and Fengqiu gates became Primordial Transformation and Xuan Yang; the eastern Cao and Song gates became Welcoming Spring and Renhe.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以右金吾大將軍馬從斌為契丹國信使，考功郎中劉知新副之。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Ma Congbin, Grand General of the Right Golden Guard, was made envoy of credence to the Khitan; Liu Zhixin, Director of the Bureau of Merit, served as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Ma Congbin, Grand General of the Right Golden Guard, was appointed credence envoy to the Khitan, with Liu Zhixin, Director of the Bureau of Merit, as deputy.

sentences.zh: 以前天平軍節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事安審琦為晉昌軍節度使，行京兆尹。

translations.literal: An Shenqi, former military governor of the Tianping Army, Grand Preceptor by examination, and Associate Chief Minister, was made military governor of the Jinchang Army and acting Jingzhao Grand Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenqi, former military governor of Tianping, examined Grand Preceptor, and Associate Chief Minister, was appointed military governor of Jinchang and acting Jingzhao Grand Administrator.

sentences.zh: 襄州奏，江水漲害稼。

translations.literal: Xiang Prefecture reported that the river waters rose and harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangzhou reported that rising river waters damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以樞密使、中書侍郎平章事、集賢殿大學士桑維翰兼兵部尚書，皆罷樞密使。

translations.literal: On renchen, Sang Weihan, Privy Council commissioner, Vice Director of the Secretariat and Chief Minister, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Assembling Worthies, was additionally made Minister of War; all were removed as Privy Council commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Sang Weihan, Privy Council commissioner, Vice Director of the Secretariat and Chief Minister, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Assembling Worthies, was additionally appointed Minister of War; the Privy Council commissioners were all dismissed.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket marking the start of an explanatory note.
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （案：以上疑有闕文。
