translations.idiomatic: (Note: The passage above appears to contain missing text.

sentences.zh: 據《通鑒考異》引《晉高祖實錄》，維翰與李崧並罷樞密使。）〉

translations.literal: According to the Tongjian kaoyi citing the Veritable Record of Emperor Gaozu of Jin, Weihan and Li Song were both removed as Privy Council commissioners.)〉
translations.idiomatic: According to the Tongjian kaoyi citing the Veritable Record of Emperor Gaozu of Jin, both Sang Weihan and Li Song were dismissed as Privy Council commissioners.)〉

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大赦天下，以魏府初平故也。

translations.literal: On wuxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm because Weifu had just been pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm because Weifu had just been pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚子，楊光遠朝覲到闕，對於便殿，錫賫甚厚。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Yang Guangyuan arrived at court for an audience; he was received in the side hall and granted lavish gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Yang Guangyuan arrived at court for an audience; he was received in the side hall and granted lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 于闐國王李聖天冊封為大寶于闐國王。

translations.literal: Li Shengtian, king of Khotan, was invested by patent as Great Treasure King of Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shengtian, king of Khotan, was invested by patent as Great Treasure King of Khotan.

sentences.zh: 以杭州嘉興縣為秀州，從錢元瓘之奏也。

translations.literal: Jiaxing County of Hang Prefecture was made Xi Prefecture, following Qian Yuanguan's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxing County in Hangzhou was established as Xi Prefecture, following a memorial from Qian Yuanguan.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，樞密直學士、祠部員外郎吳涓進金部郎中、知制誥，樞密直學士、庫部員外郎吳承範進祠部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on jiachen, Wu Juan, Privy Council direct academician and Outer Official of the Bureau of Sacrifices, was promoted to Director of the Bureau of Finance and appointed drafter of edicts; Wu Chengfang, Privy Council direct academician and Outer Official of the Bureau of Storehouses, was promoted to Director of the Bureau of Sacrifices and appointed drafter of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, Wu Juan, Privy Council direct academician and Outer Official of the Bureau of Sacrifices, was promoted to Director of the Bureau of Finance and appointed drafter of edicts; Wu Chengfang, Privy Council direct academician and Outer Official of the Bureau of Storehouses, was promoted to Director of the Bureau of Sacrifices and appointed drafter of edicts.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，鄆州範延光來朝。

translations.literal: On yisi, Fan Yanguang of Yan Prefecture came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Fan Yanguang of Yanzhou came to court.

sentences.zh: 丙午，封閩王昶為閩國王，加食邑一萬五千戶。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Prince Chang of Min was enfeoffed as King of Min, with an additional enfeoffment income of fifteen thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Prince Chang of Min was enfeoffed as King of Min, with an additional fief income of fifteen thousand households.

sentences.zh: 又以中吳建武等軍節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、蘇州誠州刺史錢元尞為太傅，以清海軍節度使、廣州刺史錢元璹為檢校太尉、兼中書令，仍改名元懿。

translations.literal: Qian Yuanliao, military governor of the Zhongwu and Jianwu armies and others, Grand Preceptor by examination, concurrently Director of the Secretariat, and Prefect of Suzhou's Chen Prefecture, was made Grand Tutor; Qian Yuanshuang, military governor of the Qinghai Army and Prefect of Guang, was made Grand Preceptor by examination and concurrently Director of the Secretariat, and his name was also changed to Yuanyi.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yuanliao, military governor of Zhongwu and Jianwu and others, examined Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat, and prefect of Chenzhou in Suzhou, was appointed Grand Tutor; Qian Yuanshuang, military governor of Qinghai and prefect of Guangzhou, was made examined Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat, and his name was changed to Yuanyi.

sentences.zh: 應有魏府行營將校及六軍諸道、本城將校等，並與加恩。

translations.literal: All officers of the Weifu field headquarters and of the six armies, various circuits, and the capital garrison, among others, were likewise granted favor.
translations.idiomatic: All officers of the Weifu field headquarters, the six armies, the various circuits, and the capital garrison were likewise granted honors.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以門下侍郎平章事、監修國史、判戶部趙瑩兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On wushen, Zhao Ying, Vice Director of the Chancellery and Chief Minister, supervisor of the compilation of the national history, and adjudicator of the Bureau of Revenue, was additionally made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhao Ying, Vice Director of the Chancellery and Chief Minister, supervisor of the national history, and adjudicator of the Bureau of Revenue, was additionally appointed Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 以威武軍節度、福建管內觀察處置等使王繼恭為特進、檢校太傅，仍封臨海郡王。

translations.literal: Wang Jigong, military governor of the Weiwu Army and commissioner for observation and disposition within Fujian, was made Special Advancement and Grand Tutor by examination, and was still enfeoffed as Prince of the Linhai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jigong, military governor of Weiwu and commissioner for observation and disposition in Fujian, was granted Special Advancement and appointed examined Grand Tutor, and was also enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai.

sentences.zh: 以魏博節度使楊光遠為守太尉、洛京留守，兼河陽節度使，判六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Weibo, was made acting Grand Preceptor, Luoyang garrison commissioner, and concurrently military governor of Heyang, with charge over the six armies and the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Weibo, was appointed acting Grand Preceptor, Luoyang garrison commissioner, and concurrent military governor of Heyang, with charge over the six armies and the various guards.

sentences.zh: 端明殿學士、尚書禮部侍郎、判度支和凝改尚書戶部侍郎充職。

translations.literal: He Ning, academician of the Duanming Hall, Vice Minister of Rites in the Department of State Affairs, and adjudicator of the Bureau of Revenue, was changed to Vice Minister of Households in the Department of State Affairs to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: He Ning, academician of the Duanming Hall, Vice Minister of Rites, and adjudicator of the Bureau of Revenue, was transferred to Vice Minister of Households to fill the post.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，鄆州範延光上表乞休退，詔不允。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Fan Yanguang of Yan Prefecture submitted a memorial begging to retire; an edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Fan Yanguang of Yanzhou submitted a memorial requesting retirement; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，升廣晉府為鄴都，置留守。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Guangjin Prefecture was elevated to the capital of Ye, and a garrison commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Guangjin Prefecture was elevated to the capital of Ye, and a garrison commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 升廣晉、元城兩縣為赤縣，屬府諸縣升為畿縣。

translations.literal: Guangjin and Yuancheng counties were elevated to imperial counties; the counties under the prefecture were elevated to capital-district counties.
translations.idiomatic: Guangjin and Yuancheng counties were elevated to imperial counties; the counties under the prefecture were elevated to capital-district counties.

sentences.zh: 升相州為彰德軍，置節度觀察使，以澶、衛二州為屬郡，其澶州仍升為防禦州，移於德勝口為治所。

translations.literal: Xiang Prefecture was elevated to the Zhangde Army; a military governor and observation commissioner was established; Chan and Wei prefectures were made subordinate commanderies; Chan Prefecture was further elevated to a defense prefecture, with its seat moved to Deshengkou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangzhou was elevated to the Zhangde Army; a military governor and observation commissioner was appointed; Chanzhou and Weizhou were made subordinate prefectures; Chanzhou was further elevated to a defense prefecture, with its seat moved to Deshengkou.

sentences.zh: 升貝州為永清軍，置節度觀察使，以博、冀二州為屬郡。

translations.literal: Bei Prefecture was elevated to the Yongqing Army; a military governor and observation commissioner was established; Bo and Ji prefectures were made subordinate commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Beizhou was elevated to the Yongqing Army; a military governor and observation commissioner was appointed; Bozhou and Jizhou were made subordinate prefectures.

sentences.zh: 以西京留守高行周為廣晉尹、鄴都留守；

translations.literal: Gao Xingzhou, regent of the Western Capital, was made Guangjin Grand Administrator and regent of the capital of Ye;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xingzhou, regent of the Western Capital, was appointed Guangjin Grand Administrator and regent of the capital at Ye;

sentences.zh: 廣晉府行營中軍使、貝州防禦使王庭允加檢校太傅，充相州彰德軍節度使；

translations.literal: Wang Tingyun, central army commander of the Guangjin field headquarters and defense commissioner of Bei Prefecture, was made honorary Grand Tutor and appointed military governor of the Zhangde Army at Xiang Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tingyun, central army commander of the Guangjin headquarters and defense commissioner of Beizhou, was promoted to honorary Grand Tutor and military governor of the Zhangde Army at Xiangzhou;

sentences.zh: 廣晉府行營步軍都指揮使、右神武統軍王周為貝州永清軍節度使。

translations.literal: Wang Zhou, foot commander of the Guangjin field headquarters and commander of the Right Shenwu Army, was made military governor of the Yongqing Army at Bei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhou, foot commander of the Guangjin headquarters and commander of the Right Shenwu Army, was appointed military governor of the Yongqing Army at Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以範延光為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Fan Yanguang was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Fan Yanguang was appointed Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired from active service.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以秘書監呂琦為禮部侍郎，歸德軍節度使趙在禮改天平軍節度使，昭義軍節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都虞候杜重威改忠武軍節度使，忠武軍節度使、侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使劉知遠改歸德軍節度使，前河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使侯益改昭義軍節度使。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Lü Qi, Director of the Palace Library, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Zhao Zaili, military governor of the Guide Army, was changed to military governor of the Tianping Army; Du Chongwei, military governor of Zhaoyi and chief adjutant of the Palace Guard horse and foot, was changed to military governor of the Zhongwu Army; Liu Zhiyuan, military governor of Zhongwu and commander-in-chief of the Palace Guard horse and foot, was changed to military governor of the Guide Army; Hou Yi, former military governor of Heyang and commander of the Fengguo left and right wings, was changed to military governor of Zhaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Lü Qi, Director of the Palace Library, became Vice Minister of Rites; Zhao Zaili of Guide was transferred to Tianping; Du Chongwei of Zhaoyi, chief adjutant of the Palace Guard, was transferred to Zhongwu; Liu Zhiyuan of Zhongwu, commander of the Palace Guard, was transferred to Guide; and Hou Yi, former governor of Heyang and commander of the Fengguo wings, was transferred to Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，割濮州濮陽縣棣澶州。

translations.literal: On guihai, Puyang county of Pu Prefecture was detached and assigned to Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Puyang county was detached from Puzhou and assigned to Chanzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔許天下私鑄錢，以「天福元寶」為文。

translations.literal: An edict permitted private casting of coin throughout the realm, with the inscription "Tianfu yuanbao."
translations.idiomatic: An edict permitted private coinage throughout the empire, inscribed with the legend "Tianfu yuanbao."

sentences.zh: 丙寅冬至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the winter solstice, the Emperor attended the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and insignia followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: On the winter solstice, bingyin, the emperor held audience in the Chongyuan Hall to receive felicitations; the guard of honor followed the usual form.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌朔，以前兵部尚書梁文矩為太子太師，以鎮州節度副使符蒙為右諫議大夫，以吏部郎中曹國珍為左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On the first day (jiaxu) of the twelfth month, the former Minister of War Liang Wenju was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; Fu Meng, deputy military governor of Zhen Prefecture, was made Right Remonstrance Councilor; Cao Guozhen, section member of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Left Remonstrance Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, the former Minister of War Liang Wenju was appointed Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; Fu Meng, deputy military governor of Zhenzhou, became Right Remonstrance Councilor; and Cao Guozhen, a section member in the Ministry of Personnel, became Left Remonstrance Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以前涇州彰義軍節度使李德充為晉州建雄軍節度使，加同平章事。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Li Dechong, former military governor of the Zhangyi Army at Jing Prefecture, was made military governor of the Jianxiong Army at Jin Prefecture and made Associate Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Li Dechong, former military governor of Zhangyi at Jingzhou, was appointed military governor of the Jianxiong Army at Jinzhou and Associate Chief Minister.

sentences.zh: 以皇太子右金吾衛上將軍重貴為檢校太傅、開封尹，封鄭王，加食邑三千戶。

translations.literal: Chonggui, senior general of the Right Golden Crow Guard under the Heir Apparent, was made honorary Grand Tutor and metropolitan administrator of Kaifeng, enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, and granted an additional three thousand households of fief income.
translations.idiomatic: Chonggui, senior general of the Right Golden Crow Guard to the Heir Apparent, was appointed honorary Grand Tutor and metropolitan administrator of Kaifeng, enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, and granted three thousand additional households of fief income.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，制以大寶于闐國進奉使、檢校太尉馬繼榮為鎮國大將軍，使副黃門將軍、國子少監張再通為試衛尉卿，監使殿頭承旨、通事舍人吳順規為試將作少監。

translations.literal: On wuyin, by patent Ma Jirong, tribute envoy of Great Treasure Khotan and honorary Grand Marshal, was made General Who Stabilizes the State; Zhang Zaitong, deputy envoy, General of the Yellow Gate, and Vice Director of the Directorate of Education, was made acting Commandant of the Court of the Imperial Guards; Wu Shungui, supervising envoy, palace head bearer of edicts and Drafting Attendant, was made acting Vice Director of the Directorate of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Ma Jirong, tribute envoy of Great Treasure Khotan and honorary Grand Marshal, was appointed General Who Stabilizes the State; his deputy Zhang Zaitong, General of the Yellow Gate and Vice Director of the Directorate of Education, was made acting Commandant of the Court of the Imperial Guards; and Wu Shungui, supervising envoy and palace edict bearer, was made acting Vice Director of the Directorate of Works.

sentences.zh: 回鶻使都督李萬金可歸義大將軍，監使雷德順為順化將軍。

translations.literal: Li Wanjin, commissioner of the Uyghur envoy, was made General of Righteous Submission; Lei Deshun, supervising envoy, was made General of Harmonious Transformation.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wanjin, commissioner of the Uyghur mission, was appointed General of Righteous Submission; Lei Deshun, supervising envoy, was appointed General of Harmonious Transformation.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔：「宜令天下無問公私，應有銅欲鑄錢者，一任取便酌量輕重鑄造。

translations.literal: That day, an edict said: "It is fitting to order that throughout the realm, without distinction of public or private, whoever has copper and wishes to cast coin may freely determine weight and cast as convenient."
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict declared: "Throughout the empire, whether public or private, anyone with copper who wishes to cast coin may do so freely, determining weight as they see fit."

sentences.zh: 」戊子，以河陽潛龍舊宅為開晉禪院，邢州潛龍舊宅為廣法禪院。

translations.literal: " On wuzi, the former Hidden Dragon residence at Heyang was made the Kaijin Chan monastery; the former Hidden Dragon residence at Xing Prefecture was made the Guangfa Chan monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the former Hidden Dragon residence at Heyang was converted into the Kaijin Chan monastery, and the former Hidden Dragon residence at Xingzhou into the Guangfa Chan monastery.

sentences.zh: 龍武統軍李從昶卒，輟朝一日，贈太尉。

translations.literal: Li Congchang, commander of the Dragon Martial Army, died; court audiences were suspended for one day; he was posthumously granted Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Li Congchang, commander of the Dragon Martial Army, died; court audiences were suspended for one day, and he was posthumously granted the title Grand Marshal.
